cards.title: OpenAI Raises $11B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI has reportedly secured an additional $11 billion in funding as part of an ongoing round expected to close in coming weeks. The raise values the company at $1.25 trillion.

cards.title: OpenAI President Says IPO Possible in 2027
cards.body: Greg Brockman stated at a Wall Street Journal conference that OpenAI could be IPO-ready by 2027. The executive highlighted the company's growing enterprise market traction against rival Anthropic.

cards.title: OpenAI Releases New Cybersecurity Model
cards.body: OpenAI unveiled a new cybersecurity model amid industry scrutiny over AI labs' digital infrastructure protection efforts. The release addresses growing concerns about AI's role in securing critical systems.

cards.title: Claude Gets Personal Finance Tool
cards.body: Anthropic's Claude now offers a Personal Finance tool that connects to bank and card accounts via Plaid. Users can ask questions about their spending and financial data directly.

cards.title: Meta Launches Spaces for Muse Agents
cards.body: Meta introduced Spaces, a new collaboration feature for its Muse AI agents. The platform expands how users interact with Meta's AI helpers.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Avatar Now Video Calls
cards.body: US users can now video chat with customizable Muse AI avatars, ahead of a Tamagotchi-like wearable launch. The feature brings animated AI interactions to video communication.

cards.title: Meta Warns Data Center Backlash Threatens AI
cards.body: Meta cautioned that growing political opposition to data centers could hinder future AI expansion. Communities are increasingly pushing back against massive infrastructure projects.

cards.title: Amazon Enables Text Commands for Alexa
cards.body: Amazon is rolling out text-to-Alexa functionality to millions of users in coming weeks. Users can now text Alexa to help them shop and complete other tasks.

cards.title: Airbnb Launching AI Travel Agent in 2027
cards.body: Airbnb announced an AI travel agent launching in H1 2027 to help plan trips and manage bookings. The agent will provide assistance throughout users' entire travel experience.

cards.title: Crusoe Sells Wyoming Data Center to Google
cards.body: Crusoe Energy sold its troubled Wyoming data center project to Google, highlighting AI infrastructure challenges. The deal underscores difficulties in developing massive AI computing facilities.

cards.title: Palo Alto Networks Acquires Clutch for $500M
cards.body: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire AI agent security startup Clutch for approximately $500 million. Clutch was previously valued at $85 million by backers Lightspeed and SignalFire.

cards.title: Underdog Shows 32MB Speech Generation Model
cards.body: Underdog demonstrated a remarkably small 32MB speech model capable of generating speech and music. Despite its compact size, the model showcases efficient AI capabilities.

cards.title: Physicl Raises $10M for Robot Simulation
cards.body: Physicl secured $10 million to bridge the sim-to-real gap for robotics using digital-to-physical pipelines. The company adapts e-commerce technology to improve robot training and deployment.

cards.title: Axiom Math Verifies Major Mathematics Library
cards.body: Axiom Math's AI agents formally verified the Stacks Project, a major mathematics library, using formal verification. The startup aims to prevent unvalidated AI proofs from flooding mathematical research.

cards.title: AI Spending Stalls Despite Growing Usage
cards.body: Ramp data reveals AI spending has plateaued even as usage continues climbing. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among major spenders could challenge investor assumptions about hypergrowth.

cards.title: Midterm Elections Threaten Data Center Expansion
cards.body: Voters approved restrictions on data centers in 40 of 41 ballot measures during midterm elections. The Democratic wave could reshape tech industry AI infrastructure development for years.

cards.title: Artex AI Hacking Tools Found Exposed Online
cards.body: Security researchers discovered hundreds of publicly exposed servers hosting Artex AI penetration testing tools. The exposure allowed unrestricted access to the hacking tools.

cards.title: China Allegedly Recruited Spy on Nvidia CEO
cards.body: A US intelligence memo reportedly detailed China's Ministry of State Security recruiting a female tech executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO. The allegation highlights escalating corporate espionage tensions.

cards.title: Post-Midterms: Rocky Times Ahead for Tech
cards.body: Election results and data center restrictions pose challenges for Elon Musk and other tech leaders. Industry uncertainty grows as political winds shift against major infrastructure expansion.

cards.title: AI Industry Faces Rough Two-Year Outlook
cards.body: Democratic midterm victories threaten AI expansion as communities push back on data center development. Political headwinds could reshape the industry's growth trajectory significantly.

cards.title: Humanoid Robot Cleaning Service Arrives in SF
cards.body: A new humanoid-robot cleaning service is launching in San Francisco, offering a glimpse into the future of domestic automation. The technology represents a practical application of AI-powered robotics in everyday life.

cards.title: Texas AI Data Center Boom at Risk
cards.body: Texas has been the epicenter of Big Tech's largest AI data center buildouts, but recent political shifts may jeopardize its position. The state's fastest-growing data center market faces uncertainty amid changing policy priorities.

cards.title: Reverse Game Theory Controls Powerful AI Agents
cards.body: A new approach called 'reverse game theory' aims to keep powerful AI models in check through strategic design. This method offers a path to controlling increasingly autonomous AI agents in enterprise settings.

cards.title: Securing Agentic Enterprise Systems With Data Lineage
cards.body: Multiple AI agents pulling data from various sources can create security vulnerabilities in enterprise workflows. Data lineage tracking becomes critical as autonomous AI systems make decisions based on aggregated information.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Summoned by Congress on Chinese Espionage
cards.body: Jensen Huang faces congressional scrutiny over potential Chinese espionage concerns related to Nvidia's AI hardware exports. The hearing reflects growing national security tensions around advanced AI technology distribution.
